headline: Bladex Commercial Portfolio Reaches Record $15 Billion in Q3
summary: Banco Latinoamericano de Comercio Exterior reported its Q3 2026 results, showing that its commercial portfolio expanded to a record $15 billion.
why: Bladex is a multinational bank established by central banks of Latin America and the Caribbean to promote foreign trade and regional economic integration.

impacts.name: Bladex
impacts.why: A record commercial loan portfolio directly supports net interest income expansion for the trade-finance bank.
